summary: Kerb along the Coles blank wall; no homes near but a busy narrow road.
reasons: Blank retail wall, no dwellings nearby
Busy through road beside a junction
Few cars clearly parked at this kerb

best_section.where: East kerb of Swann Road alongside the Coles Local wall, south of the junction

drivers.seclusion: Coles wall on own side and commercial buildings opposite; the nearest dwelling is far off.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with a kerb; one car and a truck stand at the kerb near the south end, but the lane is narrow and a van may stick into it.
drivers.traffic: Busy road between a junction and a rail bridge; queuing cars at the north end.
drivers.convention: Some cars stop at the east kerb, but no clear parking lane and a keep-clear marking nearby.

flags: Noise: busy road and rail line 20-30 m away
Keep-clear marking on the road near the junction
Red-surfaced kerb patch at the south end
sun_shade: Coles building shades the kerb from the east and the morning sun; open to the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the kerb is a loading zone or bus stop
